ablation: Member 0 ALONE with the CALIB-01 Gaussian bridge on its own stated sigma (ounc/runc/sigma_u): the no-ensemble control. Same o sequence (member-0 events), same gate. Isolates the ensembling contribution: if the ablation beats the ensemble, disagreement adds nothing.
baseline: Sequential Laplace-smoothed climatology computed on THIS family's own o sequence (member-0 realized events). The baseline must face the same outcomes the estimator is scored on.
conditions: changing_rule v1.0.0, arch_b, affect='none', action_mode default, 10 episodes x 5 fresh seeds {73601,73602,73603,73604,73605}. Per env-seed: N=5 ArchB members, member m agent seed = derive_seed(s, m, 'ensemble-member'); each member runs run_closed_loop independently (deterministic, equivalent to lockstep) with its own env instance and the SAME env episode seeds (identical env dynamics; trajectories diverge only via agent init). PredictionLog JSONL per member per seed. Per env-seed, truncate all members to the minimum tick count across members; any truncation reported. Pooled over seeds in seed order = 1950 ticks/domain expected. Deterministic; stdlib only.
decision_use_protocol: SHARED (program step 3), runs ONLY if this family passes the gate. DU1 (D3 defer): online ensemble; per tick if p_D3 > 0.5 take uniform-random action (seeded stream derive_seed(s,0,'defer')), else the primary member's action. DU2 (D4 retrieval gate): per tick when a correction is available, apply iff p_D4 > 0.5 else skip. Arms paired on 4 fresh seeds {73701,73702,73703,73704} x 10 episodes changing_rule. Metric: mean episode return. Win: seed-mean Delta(gated-blind) > 0 AND >=3/4 seeds agree on sign. Firing rate reported; rate 0 = decision-inert finding. Family is DECISION-USEFUL iff gate pass AND >=1 DU win; calibrated-but-inert caps at INTEGRATED.

member_event.D1: o_m = 1(mean_abs_error_m <= EPS_OBS) from member m's own next_obs records
member_event.D2: o_m = 1(abs_error_m <= EPS_RW) from member m's own action_consequence records
member_event.D4: o_m = 1(benefit_m > 0) from member m's own retrieval_usefulness records

estimator_spec.outcome_o: o_t = member 0's event (the designated primary). All members face identical env dynamics (same env seeds), so member 0's outcome is a valid draw from the distribution the ensemble characterizes.
estimator_spec.probability: p_t = (1/N) * sum_m o_m: the ensemble vote fraction. Clamped to [1e-9, 1-1e-9].
estimator_spec.sigma_for_corr: std across members of the member y values at tick t (1.0 if N<2).

family: (c) ensemble disagreement over N predictor seeds
frozen_gates: G0 fabrication-tripwire CLEAN on new code, pre-run
G1 determinism spot-check: seed 73601 member 0 recomputed -> JSONL bytes identical, else VOID
G2 hash-chained receipt via harness.write_receipt + verify_chain
gate: SHARED GATE (program step 1): PASS iff Brier_ens < Brier_climo on >=3/4 domains (>=3/4 bar follows lab precedent EXP-FP-0070/71/72). corr(sigma,|err|) reported, no threshold. REJECT otherwise: full negative-result entry, move on. No exceptions, no 'promising direction' softening.
hypothesis: Ensemble vote fractions over N=5 predictor seeds beat sequential climatology on >=3/4 calibration domains: Brier_ens < Brier_climo.
limitations_preregistered: Single env (changing_rule); ensemble diversity comes only from agent init seeds (same architecture, same env dynamics).
o_t is member 0's outcome, not the ensemble-mean prediction's outcome (limitation of the vote-fraction design; preregistered).
maturity_mapping: Gate pass -> EXECUTED with measured Brier skill. DU win -> CAUSAL. Gate fail -> REJECTED + NR entry.
null: Brier_ens >= Brier_climo on >=2/4 domains (fails the >=3/4 bar): ensemble disagreement carries no probabilistic information beyond the running base rate.
preregistered_metric: Per-domain Brier_ens vs Brier_climo (sequential Laplace-smoothed climatology on member-0's o sequence), scored by benchmarks/calibration_battery.py score_domain on the pooled tick stream. PASS iff Brier_ens < Brier_climo on >=3/4 domains. A domain scoring UNMEASURABLE under CALIB-01's gates counts as not-beaten. corr(sigma,|err|) reported per domain (Pearson, pooled scored ticks); no threshold (supplementary, per program step 1).
seed_freshness: 73601-73605 verified absent from all receipts, preregistrations, and driver files (grep 2026-10-07). No overlap with calib 73101-73105 or any other experiment's seeds.
